title: §8-22: Sealed-system leak cycle (E CH / E CL)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing electrical parts. R-600a is flammable — follow sealed-system precautions for CH/CL codes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. R-600a refrigerant precautions apply.

steps.title: E CH or E CL active?
steps.body: CH = high-side leak cycle; CL = low-side leak cycle on R-600a linear compressor platform.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CH = high-side leak cycle; CL = low-side leak cycle on R-600a linear compressor platform.

steps.title: UV leak detection
steps.body: Follow §8-22 steps: verify error code, inspect sealed system, check restriction/compressor, high/low side parts, then UV driver leak check.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Follow §8-22 steps: verify error code, inspect sealed system, check restriction/compressor, high/low side parts, then UV driver leak check.

steps.title: Sealed-system repair
steps.oemOutcome: Repair refrigerant leak, restriction, or compressor per OEM sealed-system procedure.

steps.title: No leak code
steps.oemOutcome: E CH/E CL not present — investigate other cooling faults.
